title: The Insane Story Behind John DeLorean
description:
He was the youngest division head General Motors ever had. He walked away from it in nineteen seventy-three, built a stainless steel sports car in Northern Ireland, and was arrested in a Los Angeles hotel room on the nineteenth of October nineteen eighty-two. A jury later acquitted him on all eight charges. This is the story of John DeLorean, and every claim comes from a named source. We used Wikipedia's pages on John DeLorean and on the DeLorean car, Encyclopedia dot com's account of the nineteen eighty-four trial, EBSCO's research starter, Ate Up With Motor, ThePricer and Business Insider. These sources disagree about numbers, dates and even a famous quote. We show those disagreements. Our own arithmetic is labelled.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
